/**
 * emergency-engine.ts —— 临期应急建议引擎（纯函数）
 *
 * 规则引擎，5 条确定性规则，命中即生成建议
 * 全部输出草稿态 proposal（type=emergency），用户确认才执行
 * 无 LLM 调用，每条建议都有明确的 rationale 可解释
 */
 
type TaskStatus = 'todo' | 'in_progress' | 'done' | 'blocked' | 'cancelled'
type TaskPriority = 'low' | 'medium' | 'high' | 'urgent'
 
interface EmergencyTask {
  id: string
  title?: string
  status: TaskStatus
  progress: number
  estimatedHours: number
  dueDate?: Date
  assigneeId?: string
  priority: TaskPriority
}
 
interface EmergencyDependency {
  id: string
  fromTaskId: string
  toTaskId: string
  type: string
}
 
interface MemberLoad {
  assigneeId: string
  inProgressCount: number
  totalHours: number
}
 
export interface EmergencyInput {
  projectId: string
  projectName?: string
  tasks: EmergencyTask[]
  dependencies?: EmergencyDependency[]
  memberLoads?: MemberLoad[]
  now?: Date
  focusAreas?: string[]
}
 
export type EmergencyActionType =
  | 'rush'            // 加班冲刺
  | 'reassign'        // 重新分配
  | 'split'           // 拆解并行
  | 'de-prioritize'   // 降低优先级
  | 'extend_deadline' // 延期
  | 'freeze_scope'    // 冻结范围
 
export interface EmergencyAction {
  id: string
  actionType: EmergencyActionType
  title: string
  rationale: string
  impact: string
  targetTaskIds: string[]
  targetAssigneeIds?: string[]
  effortHours?: number
  riskReductionEstimate?: number // 预估可减少的风险分数 0-30
}
 
export interface EmergencySuggestionResult {
  projectId: string
  actions: EmergencyAction[]
  riskScoreBefore: number // 预估应用前风险分 0-100（越高越危险）
  riskScoreAfterEstimate: number // 预估应用后
  summary: string
  generatedAt: Date
}
 
/** 生成应急建议 */
export function generateEmergencySuggestions(input: EmergencyInput): EmergencySuggestionResult {
  const now = input.now ?? new Date()
  const { tasks, dependencies = [], memberLoads = [] } = input
  const actions: EmergencyAction[] = []
 
  const activeTasks = tasks.filter(t => t.status !== 'done' && t.status !== 'cancelled')
  const threeDaysMs = 3 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000
 
  // ========= 规则 1：单任务临期且只差少量工时 → 加班冲刺 =========
  const rushTasks = activeTasks.filter(t => {
    if (!t.dueDate) return false
    const diffMs = t.dueDate.getTime() - now.getTime()
    const remainingHours = t.estimatedHours * (1 - t.progress / 100)
    return diffMs > 0 && diffMs <= threeDaysMs && remainingHours <= 8 && t.progress > 0
  })
 
  if (rushTasks.length > 0 && rushTasks.length <= 3) {
    actions.push({
      id: 'action-rush',
      actionType: 'rush',
      title: `集中冲刺 ${rushTasks.length} 个临期任务`,
      rationale: `${rushTasks.length} 个任务 3 天内到期，剩余工时均 ≤ 8 小时，短期集中投入可按期交付`,
      impact: `预计可将 ${rushTasks.length} 个临期任务转为按期交付`,
      targetTaskIds: rushTasks.map(t => t.id),
      effortHours: rushTasks.reduce((sum, t) => sum + t.estimatedHours * (1 - t.progress / 100), 0),
      riskReductionEstimate: rushTasks.length * 5,
    })
  }
 
  // ========= 规则 2：关键路径阻塞 → 指派高优处理 =========
  const blockedTasks = activeTasks.filter(t => t.status === 'blocked')
  if (blockedTasks.length > 0) {
    // 找出被阻塞影响最多下游任务的阻塞点
    const downstreamCount = new Map<string, number>()
    for (const t of blockedTasks) {
      let count = 0
      const visited = new Set<string>()
      const queue = [t.id]
      while (queue.length > 0) {
        const current = queue.shift()!
        Iif (visited.has(current)) continue
        visited.add(current)
        const deps = dependencies.filter(d => d.fromTaskId === current)
        for (const d of deps) {
          Eif (!visited.has(d.toTaskId)) {
            queue.push(d.toTaskId)
            count++
          }
        }
      }
      downstreamCount.set(t.id, count)
    }
 
    const topBlocked = [...blockedTasks].sort(
      (a, b) => (downstreamCount.get(b.id) ?? 0) - (downstreamCount.get(a.id) ?? 0),
    )[0]
    const impactCount = downstreamCount.get(topBlocked.id) ?? 0
 
    actions.push({
      id: 'action-unblock',
      actionType: 'reassign',
      title: '优先解决关键阻塞点',
      rationale: `任务「${topBlocked.title ?? topBlocked.id}」被阻塞，影响下游 ${impactCount} 个任务，是当前最大瓶颈`,
      impact: `解除阻塞后可释放 ${impactCount} 个下游任务的推进空间`,
      targetTaskIds: [topBlocked.id],
      riskReductionEstimate: Math.min(20, impactCount * 3),
    })
  }
 
  // ========= 规则 3：资源过载且有闲置成员 → 重新分配 =========
  if (memberLoads.length > 0) {
    const overloaded = memberLoads.filter(m => m.inProgressCount > 5)
    const underloaded = memberLoads.filter(m => m.inProgressCount <= 2)
 
    if (overloaded.length > 0 && underloaded.length > 0) {
      const transferableTasks = activeTasks.filter(
        t => t.status === 'in_progress' && overloaded.some(o => o.assigneeId === t.assigneeId),
      )
 
      Eif (transferableTasks.length > 0) {
        actions.push({
          id: 'action-rebalance',
          actionType: 'reassign',
          title: `重新分配任务（${overloaded.length} 人过载 → ${underloaded.length} 人闲置）`,
          rationale: `${overloaded.length} 名成员同时处理超过 5 个任务，而 ${underloaded.length} 名成员任务 ≤ 2 个，负载不均衡`,
          impact: `平衡后可减少资源浪费，提升整体吞吐`,
          targetTaskIds: transferableTasks.slice(0, 5).map(t => t.id),
          targetAssigneeIds: [...overloaded.map(m => m.assigneeId), ...underloaded.map(m => m.assigneeId)],
          riskReductionEstimate: overloaded.length * 3,
        })
      }
    }
  }
 
  // ========= 规则 4：多任务同时临期 → 优先级重排 =========
  const nearDueHighPriority = activeTasks.filter(t => {
    if (!t.dueDate) return false
    const diffMs = t.dueDate.getTime() - now.getTime()
    return diffMs > 0 && diffMs <= threeDaysMs && (t.priority === 'high' || t.priority === 'urgent')
  })
 
  const lowPriorityActive = activeTasks.filter(
    t => t.priority === 'low' && t.status !== 'blocked' && t.progress < 50,
  )
 
  if (nearDueHighPriority.length >= 3 && lowPriorityActive.length > 0) {
    actions.push({
      id: 'action-reprioritize',
      actionType: 'de-prioritize',
      title: `优先级重排：聚焦 ${nearDueHighPriority.length} 个高优临期任务`,
      rationale: `有 ${nearDueHighPriority.length} 个高优先级任务即将到期，建议暂缓 ${lowPriorityActive.length} 个低优先级任务`,
      impact: `集中资源确保高优任务按期交付，低优任务可顺延`,
      targetTaskIds: [...nearDueHighPriority.map(t => t.id), ...lowPriorityActive.map(t => t.id)],
      riskReductionEstimate: nearDueHighPriority.length * 4,
    })
  }
 
  // ========= 规则 5：scope creep → 冻结范围 + 分批交付 =========
  const totalTasks = tasks.length
  const cancelledTasks = tasks.filter(t => t.status === 'cancelled').length
  const addedVsPlanned = totalTasks > 0 && totalTasks > (input as any).plannedTaskCount
    ? totalTasks - (input as any).plannedTaskCount
    : 0
 
  if (totalTasks > 10 && cancelledTasks / totalTasks > 0.1) {
    actions.push({
      id: 'action-freeze-scope',
      actionType: 'freeze_scope',
      title: '冻结范围，聚焦核心交付',
      rationale: `取消/变更任务占比超过 10%（${cancelledTasks}/${totalTasks}），存在范围蔓延迹象`,
      impact: `冻结新增需求，确保当前范围按期交付`,
      targetTaskIds: tasks.filter(t => t.status === 'todo' && t.priority === 'low').slice(0, 5).map(t => t.id),
      riskReductionEstimate: 10,
    })
  I} else if (addedVsPlanned > 3) {
    actions.push({
      id: 'action-freeze-scope-2',
      actionType: 'freeze_scope',
      title: '警惕范围蔓延，建议分批交付',
      rationale: `项目执行中新增了 ${addedVsPlanned} 个任务，超出最初规划`,
      impact: `分批交付可降低复杂度，确保核心功能先上线`,
      targetTaskIds: [],
      riskReductionEstimate: 5,
    })
  }
 
  // 计算预估风险分
  const riskScoreBefore = estimateRiskScore(activeTasks, now)
  const totalReduction = actions.reduce((sum, a) => sum + (a.riskReductionEstimate ?? 0), 0)
  const riskScoreAfter = Math.max(0, riskScoreBefore - totalReduction)
 
  const summary = actions.length > 0
    ? `检测到 ${actions.length} 项可执行的应急措施，预计可将风险分从 ${riskScoreBefore} 降至 ${riskScoreAfter}`
    : '未检测到需要应急处理的严重风险，项目整体可控'
 
  return {
    projectId: input.projectId,
    actions,
    riskScoreBefore,
    riskScoreAfterEstimate: riskScoreAfter,
    summary,
    generatedAt: now,
  }
}
 
/** 估算风险分数（0-100，越高越危险） */
function estimateRiskScore(tasks: EmergencyTask[], now: Date): number {
  let score = 0
  const threeDaysMs = 3 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000
 
  for (const t of tasks) {
    if (t.status === 'blocked') {
      score += 15
    }
    if (t.dueDate) {
      const diff = t.dueDate.getTime() - now.getTime()
      if (diff < 0) {
        score += 20
      } else if (diff <= threeDaysMs && t.progress < 50) {
        score += 10
      }
    }
    Iif (t.priority === 'urgent' && t.status !== 'done') {
      score += 5
    }
  }
 
  return Math.min(100, score)
}
